title: pybind11 type_caster<at::Tensor>::cast appears to be leaky
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Implementation: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/torch/csrc/utils.cpp#L370
THPVariable_Wrap [returns +1](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/a74fe75c450277eb88a95c764e8b0a664a550a86/torch/csrc/autograd/python_variable.cpp#L288), but the above implementation uses py::handle, which doesn't take ownership. Bug report instead of PR because I can't commit to supporting it through merge process right now.

### Versions

main
